title: Sidewalk repairs complete!
description:
The City of San Diego is celebrating the near completion of its largest sidewalk replacement project as in-house crews delivered safer, more accessible pedestrian infrastructure to Mira Mesa and University City months faster than traditional construction methods! 👏 
 
The improvements address aging and damaged sidewalks in neighborhoods throughout University City and Mira Mesa, enhancing pedestrian safety, accessibility and walkability for residents of all ages and abilities. 
 
The sidewalk repairs are part of the City's ongoing commitment to maintaining and improving neighborhood infrastructure. 

#CityofSanDiego #SanDiego
